tip_text: Tip: In Ubuntu, paste inside the Terminal using Ctrl+Shift+V instead of Ctrl+V. Press Ctrl+Space to search curated commands.
Looking for the C: drive? In Linux, your personal files live inside 'Home' (/home/username).
Tip: Ubuntu Settings manages Displays, Wi-Fi, Sound, Dark Mode, and Ubuntu Pro subscriptions.
Tip: Use Ctrl+S to save files. For system configuration files requiring root privileges, use 'sudo nano' in the Terminal.
Tip: The Ubuntu App Center allows you to install and update verified software packages safely.
